formulas: Use-case score
Value × feasibility × data readiness, each 1 to 5
Rank ideas before building anything; a 1 on any factor sinks the use case.
Data quality dimensions
Completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, validity, uniqueness
Check each before trusting a dataset.
Rolled-up quantity
Qty per vehicle = product of quantities along the path from the part to the top
EBOM to MBOM checks
Missing, extra (plant-only), quantity difference, not in EBOM
The four classes of reconciliation issue.
Outer join with indicator
merge(how='outer', indicator=True)
left_only, right_only and both tell you what is missing where.
Effort saved
Items × minutes per item × share automated ÷ 60 × hourly cost
Check elapsed time against effort before claiming savings.
Tidy data
One row per observation, one column per variable
Most cleaning work is getting here.
Notebook to tool
Functions + main guard + requirements + a simple UI
The step from analysis to something colleagues can use.
cards: AI is the broad field; ML learns patterns from data; deep learning uses many-layered neural networks.
Models that produce new content (text, code, images) by predicting what comes next.
Engineering BOM: the product structure as designed.
Manufacturing BOM: the structure as built, with plant items, kits and consumables.
A column that identifies each row uniquely, such as part number plus parent.
A pandas table with named columns, the workhorse of data work in Python.
Split rows into groups, apply a calculation to each, combine the results.
Whether data exists, is accessible, has the right history and quality for a use case.
The measured performance of today's process, before any AI.
A Python library that turns a script into a simple web app.

formulas: Precision
TP ÷ (TP + FP)
Of the alarms raised, how many were real.
Recall
TP ÷ (TP + FN)
Of the real failures, how many were caught.
Accuracy trap
Accuracy can be 97% by predicting 'no failure' when failures are 3%
Use recall and precision for rare events.
Cost-based threshold
Choose the threshold that minimises FN × cost of a miss + FP × cost of an alarm
Process design sets the cost of an alarm.
Average precision
Area under the precision-recall curve
A threshold-free comparison for imbalanced data.
Train, validation, test
Fit on train, tune on validation or cross-validation, report once on test
Never tune on the test set.
Transfer learning
Pretrained network + small labelled set + fine-tuning
Why vision pilots can start with hundreds of images.
Temperature
Sampling weight ∝ count^(1 ÷ temperature)
Low for extraction, higher for variety.
cards: Learning a mapping from inputs to known labels.
Memorising training data so the model fails on new data.
Information about the answer sneaking into the inputs, making results look too good.
Many decision trees on random samples, voting together.
Trees built one after another, each correcting the previous ones' errors.
A small filter slid across an image to detect a pattern anywhere.
Inputs in use differ from the training data, so accuracy drops silently.
Training only on normal examples and flagging anything unusual.
A piece of text, often part of a word, that a language model reads and writes.
The transformer mechanism that lets each token weigh every other token in the context.
Generates images by removing noise step by step, guided by a prompt.
Physics-based removal of material where stress is low, under defined loads.
Many optimisations across materials, methods and goals, giving options to compare.

formulas: Annual usage cost
Questions × (tokens in × price in + tokens out × price out) ÷ 1,000,000
Usually small next to time saved.
Prompt anatomy
Role, task, context, rules, format, examples
Rules for edge cases fix most extraction errors.
Cosine similarity
1 means the same direction; Chroma distance = 1 − similarity.
RAG
Index → retrieve → augment → generate
Answers from your documents, with citations.
Hit rate at k
Share of questions whose expected document is in the top k results
Measure retrieval on its own first.
Four evaluation layers
Retrieval, correctness, faithfulness, behaviour
Look at every layer, not one number.
Citation check
Cited IDs ⊆ retrieved IDs
Catches fabricated citations in code.
Conservative value
Halve self-reported savings; use measured adoption
Decide on the floor, show the upside.
cards: The maximum tokens a model can consider in one call, including its answer.
Supplying the documents, data or tool results the model must answer from.
A fluent, confident answer that is false.
Instructions that set the assistant's role, rules and format for a conversation.
Including worked examples of input and correct output in the prompt.
Forcing the model's reply to match a JSON schema.
Instructions hidden in data that the model may follow.
A list of numbers representing the meaning of a text.
Splitting documents into passages for embedding and retrieval.
Restricting search by status, revision, plant or access rights before ranking.
A fixed reply when the documents do not contain the answer; testable in code.
Further training of a model, good for style or narrow skills, not for changing facts.
A model grading answers against a rubric; calibrate it against human grades.

formulas: Tool call
Model proposes name + arguments → code runs it → result returned
The model never executes anything itself.
Agent loop
Repeat: model → tool calls → results, until no tool calls or step limit
History is the agent's working memory.
Five workflow patterns
Chaining, routing, parallelisation, orchestrator-workers, evaluator-optimiser
Use the simplest that works.
Autonomy levels
Read → draft → act with approval → act and notify → act silently
Raise autonomy only on evidence.
Grounding check
Every number in the answer appears in a tool result
Compare answers with traces.
Lethal trifecta
Private data + untrusted content + a way to act or send out
Break or gate one leg.
Agent metrics
Success rate, tool use, grounding, safety, steps, tokens, seconds
Run each task several times.
Impact analysis saving
Changes × (hours before − review hours) × hourly cost + avoided reopened changes
The value is in collection and consistency.
cards: A model using tools in steps to complete a task, with your code in control of what runs.
The name, description and parameter definition a model sees for a tool.
Reason, act with a tool, observe the result, repeat.
A record of every model request, tool call, argument and result in a run.
A cap on loop iterations that stops runaway agents.
A workflow follows a path fixed in code; an agent chooses its own path.
A person approves defined actions before they take effect.
Code that refuses a write unless a named person has approved it.
Giving an agent only the tools and data the task needs.
An AI system able to do more than its task requires (OWASP LLM risk).
Who asked, what was proposed, who approved, what ran, and when.
Reviewers approving without reading, which turns a gate into theatre.

formulas: Integrations
Without MCP: N apps × M systems; with MCP: N clients + M servers
The business case for the protocol.
MCP roles
Host (the app) → client (one per server) → server (a system's capabilities)
The model never talks to servers directly.
Three primitives
Tools (model-chosen), resources (app or user-chosen, by URI), prompts (user-chosen templates)
Pick the primitive by who decides.
Tool annotations
readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint
Hints that drive host approval policy; trust depends on the author.
Transports
stdio (local process) or Streamable HTTP (networked, with OAuth)
Shared enterprise data belongs on HTTP servers.
Server cut
One server per business domain, split by risk
Clear tools for models, clear permissions for people.
MCP control set
Registry, identity, least privilege, validation, audit, change control, testing
Bring it to the first security review.
Fingerprint
Hash of each tool's description, schema and annotations
Detects rug pulls and unreviewed changes.
cards: An open standard for connecting AI applications to tools and data.
The AI application the user works in, such as a desktop assistant or your own agent.
A program exposing a system's tools, resources and prompts in the MCP format.
A URI pattern such as doc://{doc_id} that makes a collection addressable.
The official tool to list, call and debug an MCP server's capabilities.
The request and response message format MCP uses.
A server asking the host to ask the user a question, such as a confirmation.
A server asking the host's model to generate text.
Hidden malicious instructions in a tool's description.
A server changing its tool definitions after they were approved.
A server misusing tokens or rights it holds on behalf of someone else.
The standard by which a user grants an application a scoped token to act for them.

formulas: Three stages
Proof of concept (can it work) → pilot (does it work here) → production (does it keep working)
Write exit criteria before each stage.
Payback
One-time cost ÷ (annual value − annual run cost)
Simple and understood by every CFO.
NPV over 3 years
−one-time + Σ net ÷ (1 + r)^year
Discounts future savings.
Break-even assumption
The value of the key input at which NPV = 0
The most useful sentence in a pitch.
Version everything
Model version, prompts, index, tools, evaluation set
Each changes behaviour.
Release gate
Evaluation set thresholds that must pass before deployment
Exit code non-zero stops the pipeline.
Monitoring signals
Usage, feedback, refusals, tool errors, approvals, latency, tokens
Behaviour changes even when code does not.
Deployment choice
Data sensitivity, quality needed, volume and cost, latency, skills
Compare options on the customer's evaluation set.
cards: Pilots that never reach production, usually for organisational reasons.
The person who owns the KPI, the budget and the go or stop decision.
Shows which assumptions move a value case most.
Operating LLM systems: versioning, tests, gates, monitoring, feedback and incident response.
Checking question by question what a change fixed and what it broke.
A written plan for incidents, including a safe mode.
Using an exact model version instead of a moving alias.
A common interface many providers offer, which makes backends swappable.
Sending requests to different models by rules, such as data classification.
India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
A certifiable AI management system standard.
A framework with four functions: govern, map, measure, manage.
A central AI team owning platform and controls, with use cases built in departments.
